subject: general
question: Which ruler wanted to build the Alai Minar near the Qutub Minar, but could not complete it?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ala-ud-Din Khilji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alauddin Khilji **began building the **Alai Minar**, an incomplete tower in the **Qutub Complex**.
 
• Khilji chose to build a tower twice the height of the Qutub Minar after expanding the Quwwat-ul-Islam Mosque.
 
• After Alauddin Khilji's death in 1316, the Alai Minar's construction came to a standstill.
 
• The Alai Minar, a large red rubble building that stands at 2.5 metres, is still standing today.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Alauddin ** Khilji, **commonly known as Alauddin Khilji, was a Turco-Afghan ruler of the Khalji dynasty that controlled the Delhi Sultanate in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• He was born **Ali Gurshasp**. Alauddin implemented a variety of key administrative measures, including revenue controls, pricing controls, and societal improvements.
 
• The Qutub Minar is a minaret and "victory tower" that is part of the Qutub complex, which is located on the site of Lal Kot, Delhi's earliest fortified city constructed by the Tomar Rajputs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Razia Sultana **was the monarch of the Delhi Sultanate in the Indian subcontinent's northwestern region.
 
• **Nasir ud din Mahmud Shah **was the Mamluk Sultanate's seventh ruler.
 
• **Shams ud-Din Iltutmish **was the third Mamluk monarch of northern India, ruling over the erstwhile Ghurid territory.
